answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake in time-released escrow, redeemable only after a long vesting arc. One honest agent parks a single ferrous ingot and waits; a farm must freeze that same crystal-hard capital separately under every head, and none of it earns or moves while locked. The ivory economics are plain: frozen capital scales with identity count times lock length, so a thousand fakes mean a thousandfold illiquid stake. The honest solo pays once; the farmer pays per clone and cannot recycle it.
